name: Oncology
boundaries: Oncology: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.reason: The conserved-antigen, every-malignancy version is flagged there as a stricter mechanism, not a second concept.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete, one-time eradication of all metastatic solid tumors
original_dispositions.reason: Covered as a composite outcome. It was not given its own ID because it bundles immune clearance, dormancy, a selective lethal dependency, clonal extinction, and delivery.

original_dispositions.original_title: Identification and safe targeting of a universal cancer stem cell marker
original_dispositions.reason: Current reviews describe stemness as a plastic state and state that there is no universal marker. Markers such as CD44 and CD133 are shared with normal stem cells and vary by tissue. Eliminating the cells that repopulate a tumor is already the aim of ONC-03 and ONC-05.
The historical wording of 100% resection and an unstated mortality reduction was narrowed to incomplete resection and local recurrence.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe systemic reversal of the Warburg effect
original_dispositions.reason: I did not find a primary demonstration that forcing established tumors back to oxidative phosphorylation kills them while sparing normal proliferating tissue. If a selective metabolic kill of that breadth were shown, it would be one route to ONC-04, not a separate principle.

original_dispositions.original_title: Perfect multi-cancer early detection blood test with localization and subtyping
original_dispositions.reason: Localization is now explicit. The historical figures of greater than 95% sensitivity and specificity, and greater than 50% mortality reduction, were not adopted.

original_dispositions.original_title: Mechanism and safe pharmacological reversal of cancer cachexia
original_dispositions.reason: Cachexia is common and prognostic, but the cited estimate of deaths caused by cachexia is second-hand, and the same discussion says many patients die with cachexia rather than of it. Ponsegromab increased weight but did not show that wasting reversal stops death from tumor. Restoring weight and function is important care. It does not remove the tumor’s ability to kill.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal, off-the-shelf allogeneic cell therapy effective against solid tumors
original_dispositions.reason: Added in narrowed form as ONC-12. Solid-tumor efficacy is not claimed as a direct result of solving manufacture and rejection. That efficacy remains ONC-02.

original_dispositions.original_title: Discovery of a master immortality pathway beyond telomerase and alternative lengthening of telomeres, and its shutdown
original_dispositions.reason: Those two routes already partition replicative immortality. I did not find evidence of a third master pathway. Safe shutdown of telomerase, if it cured carcinomas, would be an instance of ONC-04.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe, one-time epigenetic reprogramming that normalizes cancer cells
original_dispositions.reason: A one-time reset of the cancer epigenome is one possible route to the same stable state correction.

reconciliation_change_log.change: ONC-01 through ONC-10 are preserved. No first-pass concept was deleted, replaced, or merged away.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The first-pass concepts are all retained.

reconciliation_change_log.change: ONC-01 now states that organ-of-origin localization is part of usable detection, using Neal and colleagues’ cancer-signal-origin result, and declines the historical sensitivity and mortality percentages.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical numerical claims are unverified.

reconciliation_change_log.change: ONC-02 notes the June 2026 Chinese approval of autologous satri-cel and keeps the benefit at the scale of the published progression-free-survival result.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Approval of a months-scale benefit in one antigen-selected cancer is not sterilizing clearance.

reconciliation_change_log.change: ONC-04 now records imetelstat as an achieved telomerase inhibitor for lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes, so telomere targeting is not described as untouched, and it records alternative lengthening of telomeres as the other known maintenance route.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The achieved component is distinct from a broad solid-tumor cure.

reconciliation_change_log.change: ONC-05 corrects the persister experimental paper from an unverified “Russo” attribution to Davern, Letai, and colleagues, and adds the reported phase 3 survival gain for daraxonrasib, which is still a gain of months.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The previous attribution was incorrect; the survival figure is taken from a journal comment rather than the trial paper.

reconciliation_change_log.change: ONC-06 explicitly includes one-time epigenetic reset as a route to the same state correction, and cites plasticity as the reason stability is required.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: A one-time reset is one possible route to the same end, not a separate concept.

reconciliation_change_log.change: ONC-09 distinguishes a single conserved antigen for every cancer as a stricter, less plausible version of the same prevention capability.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Future cancers often carry private mutations that do not yet exist, and shared antigens are self proteins. Feasibility of either version is uncertain.

reconciliation_change_log.change: ONC-11 is new: cell-resolution surgical margin guidance, narrowed so it does not claim control of distant disease.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical wording of 100% resection and an unstated mortality reduction was narrowed to incomplete resection and local recurrence.

reconciliation_change_log.change: ONC-12 is new: off-the-shelf cell therapy at autologous durability and ordinary scale, narrowed so solid-tumor efficacy stays in ONC-02.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Solid-tumor efficacy is not claimed as a direct result of solving manufacture and rejection.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Cachexia reversal, a universal stem-cell marker, Warburg reversal as a free-standing cure, and a third immortality pathway were not given IDs.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical-entry dispositions explain why these entries were not added as separate concepts.
